children: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark said artificial intelligence could raise U.S. GDP from about $30 trillion to $44 trillion, while warning that humanity may have only a few years to establish safeguards to keep AI under human control. According to Odaily, Clark also said AI could bring about a so-called singularity and called for global rules to prevent its misuse in biological research and cyberweapon development. Anthropic is reportedly planning an initial public offering in November, with a potential valuation of $2 trillion.

title: Anthropic Co-Founder Jack Clark: AI Could Lift U.S. GDP to $44 Trillion, Leaving Humanity Years to Build Safeguards
